verses.original: Τῇ ἐλευθερίᾳ ἡμᾶς Χριστὸς ἠλευθέρωσεν στήκετε οὖν καὶ μὴ πάλιν ζυγῷ δουλείας ἐνέχεσθε
verses.transliteration: Tē eleutheria hēmas Christos ēleutherōsen stēkete oun kai mē palin zygō douleias enechesthe
verses.literal: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free . . . Stand firm then and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery

verses.original: Ἴδε ἐγὼ Παῦλος λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν περιτέμνησθε Χριστὸς ὑμᾶς οὐδὲν ὠφελήσει
verses.transliteration: Ide egō Paulos legō hymin hoti ean peritemnēsthe Christos hymas ouden ōphelēsei
verses.literal: Take notice I Paul tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised Christ will be of no value . . . to you at all

verses.original: μαρτύρομαι δὲ πάλιν παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ περιτεμνομένῳ ὅτι ὀφειλέτης ἐστὶν ὅλον τὸν νόμον ποιῆσαι
verses.transliteration: martyromai de palin panti anthrōpō peritemnomenō hoti opheiletēs estin holon ton nomon poiēsai
verses.literal: Again I testify to every man who gets himself circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law

verses.original: κατηργήθητε ἀπὸ Χριστοῦ οἵτινες ἐν νόμῳ δικαιοῦσθε τῆς χάριτος ἐξεπέσατε
verses.transliteration: katērgēthēte apo Christou hoitines en nomō dikaiousthe tēs charitos exepesate
verses.literal: You who are trying to be justified by the law have been severed from Christ you have fallen away from grace

verses.original: Ἡμεῖς γὰρ Πνεύματι ἐκ πίστεως ἐλπίδα δικαιοσύνης ἀπεκδεχόμεθα
verses.transliteration: Hēmeis gar Pneumati ek pisteōs elpida dikaiosynēs apekdechometha
verses.literal: But by faith we eagerly await through the Spirit the hope of righteousness

verses.original: ἐν γὰρ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ οὔτε περιτομή τι ἰσχύει οὔτε ἀκροβυστία ἀλλὰ πίστις δι’ ἀγάπης ἐνεργουμένη
verses.transliteration: en gar Christō Iēsou oute peritomē ti ischyei oute akrobystia alla pistis di’ agapēs energoumenē
verses.literal: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value . . . What matters is faith expressing itself through love

verses.original: Ἐτρέχετε καλῶς τίς ὑμᾶς ἐνέκοψεν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ μὴ πείθεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Etrechete kalōs tis hymas enekopsen tē alētheia mē peithesthai
verses.literal: You were running so well Who has obstructed you from obeying the truth

verses.original: ἡ πεισμονὴ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ καλοῦντος ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: hē peismonē ouk ek tou kalountos hymas
verses.literal: Such persuasion does not come from the One who calls you

verses.original: μικρὰ ζύμη ὅλον τὸ φύραμα ζυμοῖ
verses.transliteration: mikra zymē holon to phyrama zymoi
verses.literal: A little leaven works through the whole batch of dough

verses.original: ἐγὼ πέποιθα εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν Κυρίῳ ὅτι οὐδὲν ἄλλο φρονήσετε ὁ δὲ ταράσσων ὑμᾶς βαστάσει τὸ κρίμα ὅστις ἐὰν ᾖ
verses.transliteration: egō pepoitha eis hymas en Kyriō hoti ouden allo phronēsete ho de tarassōn hymas bastasei to krima hostis ean ē
verses.literal: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view . . . . . . The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment whoever . . . he may be

verses.original: Ἐγὼ δέ ἀδελφοί εἰ περιτομὴν ἔτι κηρύσσω τί ἔτι διώκομαι ἄρα κατήργηται τὸ σκάνδαλον τοῦ σταυροῦ
verses.transliteration: Egō de adelphoi ei peritomēn eti kēryssō ti eti diōkomai ara katērgētai to skandalon tou staurou
verses.literal: Now brothers if I am still preaching circumcision why am I still being persecuted In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished

verses.original: Ὄφελον καὶ ἀποκόψονται οἱ ἀναστατοῦντες ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Ophelon kai apokopsontai hoi anastatountes hymas
verses.literal: As for those who are agitating you I wish they would proceed to emasculate themselves

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς γὰρ ἐπ’ ἐλευθερίᾳ ἐκλήθητε ἀδελφοί μόνον μὴ τὴν ἐλευθερίαν εἰς ἀφορμὴν τῇ σαρκί ἀλλὰ διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης δουλεύετε ἀλλήλοις
verses.transliteration: Hymeis gar ep’ eleutheria eklēthēte adelphoi monon mē tēn eleutherian eis aphormēn tē sarki alla dia tēs agapēs douleuete allēlois
verses.literal: For you brothers were called to freedom but do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh Rather serve one another in love

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ πᾶς νόμος ἐν ἑνὶ λόγῳ πεπλήρωται ἐν τῷ Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν
verses.transliteration: ho gar pas nomos en heni logō peplērōtai en tō Agapēseis ton plēsion sou hōs seauton
verses.literal: The entire law is fulfilled in . . . a single decree Love your neighbor as yourself

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ἀλλήλους δάκνετε καὶ κατεσθίετε βλέπετε μὴ ὑπ’ ἀλλήλων ἀναλωθῆτε
verses.transliteration: ei de allēlous daknete kai katesthiete blepete mē hyp’ allēlōn analōthēte
verses.literal: But if you keep on biting and devouring one another watch out or you will be consumed by one another

verses.original: Λέγω δέ Πνεύματι περιπατεῖτε καὶ ἐπιθυμίαν σαρκὸς οὐ μὴ τελέσητε
verses.transliteration: Legō de Pneumati peripateite kai epithymian sarkos ou mē telesēte
verses.literal: So I say walk by the Spirit and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh

verses.original: ἡ γὰρ σὰρξ ἐπιθυμεῖ κατὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος τὸ δὲ Πνεῦμα κατὰ τῆς σαρκός ταῦτα γὰρ ἀλλήλοις ἀντίκειται ἵνα μὴ ἃ ἐὰν θέλητε ταῦτα ποιῆτε
verses.transliteration: hē gar sarx epithymei kata tou Pneumatos to de Pneuma kata tēs sarkos tauta gar allēlois antikeitai hina mē ha ean thelēte tauta poiēte
verses.literal: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh They are opposed to each other so that you do not do what . . . you want

verses.original: εἰ δὲ Πνεύματι ἄγεσθε οὐκ ἐστὲ ὑπὸ νόμον
verses.transliteration: ei de Pneumati agesthe ouk este hypo nomon
verses.literal: But if you are led by the Spirit you are not under the law

verses.original: Φανερὰ δέ ἐστιν τὰ ἔργα τῆς σαρκός ἅτινά ἐστιν πορνεία ἀκαθαρσία ἀσέλγεια
verses.transliteration: Phanera de estin ta erga tēs sarkos hatina estin porneia akatharsia aselgeia
verses.literal: The acts of the flesh are obvious - sexual immorality impurity and debauchery

verses.original: εἰδωλολατρία φαρμακεία ἔχθραι ἔρις ζῆλος θυμοί ἐριθεῖαι διχοστασίαι αἱρέσεις
verses.transliteration: eidōlolatria pharmakeia echthrai eris zēlos thymoi eritheiai dichostasiai haireseis
verses.literal: idolatry and sorcery hatred discord jealousy and rage rivalries divisions factions

verses.original: φθόνοι μέθαι κῶμοι καὶ τὰ ὅμοια τούτοις ἃ προλέγω ὑμῖν καθὼς προεῖπον ὅτι οἱ τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντες βασιλείαν Θεοῦ οὐ κληρονομήσουσιν
verses.transliteration: phthonoi methai kōmoi kai ta homoia toutois ha prolegō hymin kathōs proeipon hoti hoi ta toiauta prassontes basileian Theou ou klēronomēsousin
verses.literal: and envy drunkenness orgies and the like . . . I warn you as I did before that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ καρπὸς τοῦ Πνεύματός ἐστιν ἀγάπη χαρά εἰρήνη μακροθυμία χρηστότης ἀγαθωσύνη πίστις
verses.transliteration: Ho de karpos tou Pneumatos estin agapē chara eirēnē makrothymia chrēstotēs agathōsynē pistis
verses.literal: But the fruit of the Spirit is love joy peace patience kindness goodness faithfulness

verses.original: πραΰτης ἐγκράτεια κατὰ τῶν τοιούτων οὐκ ἔστιν νόμος
verses.transliteration: prautēs enkrateia kata tōn toioutōn ouk estin nomos
verses.literal: gentleness and self-control Against such things there is no law

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τὴν σάρκα ἐσταύρωσαν σὺν τοῖς παθήμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις
verses.transliteration: Hoi de tou Christou Iēsou tēn sarka estaurōsan syn tois pathēmasin kai tais epithymiais
verses.literal: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires

verses.original: Εἰ ζῶμεν Πνεύματι Πνεύματι καὶ στοιχῶμεν
verses.transliteration: Ei zōmen Pneumati Pneumati kai stoichōmen
verses.literal: Since we live by the Spirit let us walk in step with the Spirit

verses.original: μὴ γινώμεθα κενόδοξοι ἀλλήλους προκαλούμενοι ἀλλήλοις φθονοῦντες
verses.transliteration: mē ginōmetha kenodoxoi allēlous prokaloumenoi allēlois phthonountes
verses.literal: Let us not become conceited provoking and envying one another
